name: idle-paws
description: A pixel pet (cat, dog or duck) that hangs out on your Claude window, plus mini games (2048, Sudoku, Minesweeper, Snake, Tetris) to play while Claude works.
long_description: Idle Paws adds a pixel pet that walks, sleeps and plays fetch on top of Claude's input bar, and hops when a Claude Code session finishes. Double-click the pet for the console: pet controls and games. Click Play or ask Claude to "open game" to pick a game in the side browser pane. macOS only.

tools.name: open_game
tools.description: Open the games menu (2048, Sudoku, Minesweeper, Snake, Tetris) in the browser pane
